faq.title: Expert AI Image Guidance & FAQ
faq.description: Everything you need to know about optimizing Nano Banana 2 for professional output and commercial use cases.

items.question: How do I fix a rejected visa or passport photo using Banana Pro?
items.answer: Use our AI Biometric Headshot tool to fix background requirements, adjust lighting, and ensure your photo meets official standards without manual editing.

items.question: Can I generate high-quality text for logos and branding?
items.answer: Yes, Nano Banana 2 features a specialized Typography Engine that allows for crisp, readable text integration, making it a powerful AI logo maker for startups.

items.question: Does Banana Pro support commercial usage and API integration?
items.answer: Absolutely. Banana Pro is built for professional workflows, offering commercial rights for all generated images and low-latency API access for developers.

items.question: What is SynthID and how does it protect my AI images?
items.answer: SynthID is a state-of-the-art digital watermarking technology used in Nano Banana 2 to provide content authenticity and provenance tracking for your neural art.

items.question: How can I resize images for TikTok and Instagram without cropping?
items.answer: Our Smart Aspect Ratio tool uses semantic understanding to extend backgrounds (Outpainting), allowing you to convert any image into social media reels effortlessly.
